siteAnalizi.giris: Enter your domain and we will inspect your site from the outside — speed, SEO, content, technical setup, security and AI visibility — and score it out of 100. No sign-up needed.
siteAnalizi.bekleyin: We are inspecting the site and measuring its speed; this can take about 30 seconds. Please stay on this page.
siteAnalizi.neOlcuyor: We measure speed (Google PageSpeed), SEO, content, technical setup, security headers and AI visibility. The same site can be analysed up to 3 times a day.
siteAnalizi.ozetNotu: Each section shows its three most important findings. The full report lists every finding and what to do about it.

bolumAciklama.hiz: Mobile and desktop performance, LCP, CLS and TBT via Google PageSpeed.
bolumAciklama.seo: Title, description, H1, canonical, robots.txt, sitemap and structured data.
bolumAciklama.icerik: Amount of text, image alt text and broken internal links.
bolumAciklama.teknik: HTTPS, redirects, status codes, compression and caching.
bolumAciklama.guvenlik: Security headers and SSL certificate validity.
bolumAciklama.ai: llms.txt, access for AI crawlers and structured data.

hiz_mobil.neden: Most visitors arrive on a phone, and Google ranks sites based on their mobile version.
hiz_mobil.oneri: Compress images and serve WebP/AVIF, cut unused JavaScript and inline critical CSS.

hiz_masaustu.neden: A slow page wears out the patience of visitors on work computers too.
hiz_masaustu.oneri: Use caching, compression and a CDN; load large scripts with defer.

lcp.neden: LCP measures when the main content appears; Google considers under 2.5 seconds good.
lcp.oneri: Preload the hero image, reduce its size and shorten server response time.

cls.neden: Elements that jump while loading cause misclicks and erode trust; under 0.1 is considered good.
cls.oneri: Give images and ad slots a width and height; reserve space while web fonts load.

tbt.neden: While the browser is busy the page does not respond to taps and clicks; under 200 ms is considered good.
tbt.oneri: Break up long JavaScript tasks and reduce or defer third-party scripts.

hiz_olculemedi.neden: Google PageSpeed did not respond this time; this section was left out of the overall score.
hiz_olculemedi.oneri: Try again in a few minutes or measure your site manually in PageSpeed Insights.

title_yok.neden: The title is the clickable line in search results; without it Google picks its own text.
title_yok.oneri: Give every page a unique 30–60 character <title> containing its main keyword.

title_kisa.neden: A short title wastes space in search results and does not say enough about the page.
title_kisa.oneri: Bring the title to 30–60 characters; include both the service and the brand.

title_uzun.neden: Titles over 60 characters are cut off in search results, so the key part may be hidden.
title_uzun.oneri: Shorten the title to under 60 characters and put the most important words first.

title_iyi.neden: The title is shown in full in search results.
title_iyi.oneri: Keep it up to date and unique on every page.

aciklama_yok.neden: The description is the text under the title in search results and directly affects click-through rate.
aciklama_yok.oneri: Write a 70–160 character meta description that sums up the page and invites a click.

aciklama_kisa.neden: A short description does not give visitors enough reason to click.
aciklama_kisa.oneri: Expand it to 70–160 characters and explain the benefit and what sets you apart.

aciklama_uzun.neden: Descriptions over 160 characters are cut off in search results.
aciklama_uzun.oneri: Trim it to under 160 characters and lead with the main message.

aciklama_iyi.baslik: Meta description length is good ({{deger}} characters)
aciklama_iyi.neden: The description is shown in full and summarises the page.
aciklama_iyi.oneri: Keep it in line with the page content.

h1_yok.baslik: The page has no H1 heading
h1_yok.neden: The H1 tells both visitors and search engines what the page is about.
h1_yok.oneri: Add a single H1 at the top that states the page's main topic.

h1_fazla.neden: Several H1s blur the page's main topic.
h1_fazla.oneri: Keep one H1 and turn the others into H2 or H3.

canonical_yok.neden: If the same content is reachable at several addresses, Google cannot tell which one to rank.
canonical_yok.oneri: Add a <link rel="canonical"> pointing to each page's primary address.

noindex.baslik: Page is blocked from search engines (noindex)
noindex.neden: A page with a noindex tag does not appear in Google at all.
noindex.oneri: If the page is live, remove noindex from the robots meta tag.

lang_yok.neden: The language attribute tells screen readers and search engines what language the page is in.
lang_yok.oneri: Add a lang attribute matching the page language, e.g. <html lang="en">.

robots_txt_yok.neden: robots.txt tells search engines what to crawl and where the sitemap is.
robots_txt_yok.oneri: Add a robots.txt to the root and include a Sitemap: line.

robots_engelli.baslik: robots.txt blocks search engines from the site
robots_engelli.neden: A site-wide "Disallow: /" rule stops Google from crawling your pages; the site gradually drops out of search results.
robots_engelli.oneri: Remove the "Disallow: /" line from robots.txt on the live site; block only folders that must stay private (e.g. /admin).

sitemap_yok.neden: A sitemap helps search engines find every page quickly.
sitemap_yok.oneri: Create sitemap.xml, reference it in robots.txt and submit it to Google Search Console.

sitemap_var.neden: Search engines can easily discover your pages through the sitemap.
sitemap_var.oneri: Make sure the sitemap updates automatically when you add pages.

jsonld_yok.neden: Structured data unlocks rich results such as stars, FAQs and business details.
jsonld_yok.oneri: Add schema.org JSON-LD for Organization/LocalBusiness and for each page type.

hreflang_yok.neden: If the site is published in several languages, hreflang shows each visitor the right version.
hreflang_yok.oneri: For a multilingual site, add hreflang links for every language version; a single-language site does not need them.

sayfa_basliksiz.neden: Pages without titles look weak and inconsistent in search results.
sayfa_basliksiz.oneri: Write a unique title for every crawled page.

sayfa_aciklamasiz.neden: Without a description Google shows a random snippet of text.
sayfa_aciklamasiz.oneri: Write an original meta description for all important pages.

icerik_az.baslik: The home page has little text ({{deger}} words)
icerik_az.neden: Search engines understand a page from its text; thin content is hard to rank.
icerik_az.oneri: Add at least 300 words describing your services, what sets you apart and common questions.

kelime_sayisi.neden: Enough text helps search engines understand your page correctly.
kelime_sayisi.oneri: Keep content current and break it into sections with subheadings.

alt_yok.neden: Alt text describes images to visually impaired visitors and helps image search rankings.
alt_yok.oneri: Add short alt text to every meaningful image; use alt="" for decorative ones.

alt_tamam.neden: Images are accessible and understood by search engines.
alt_tamam.oneri: Keep writing alt text for new images.

kirik_baglanti.neden: Broken links send visitors to error pages and waste crawl budget.
kirik_baglanti.oneri: Update or remove the links; set up 301 redirects for moved pages.

kirik_baglanti_yok.baslik: No broken internal links ({{deger}} links checked)
kirik_baglanti_yok.neden: Visitors and search engines can move around the site without problems.
kirik_baglanti_yok.oneri: Remember to add redirects when you delete or move pages.

https_var.neden: An encrypted connection protects visitor data; browsers flag HTTP sites as "not secure".
https_var.oneri: Make sure every resource, including images and scripts, loads over HTTPS.

https_yok.baslik: The site does not use HTTPS
https_yok.neden: Without encryption form data travels in the clear; browsers warn visitors and Google ranks the site lower.
https_yok.oneri: Install a free SSL certificate (e.g. Let's Encrypt) and redirect all traffic to HTTPS.

http_yonlendirme_yok.baslik: HTTP is not redirected to HTTPS
http_yonlendirme_yok.neden: Visitors arriving via http:// stay on the unencrypted version, creating two copies of the site.
http_yonlendirme_yok.oneri: Redirect http:// requests to https:// with a 301 on the server.

yonlendirme_uzun.baslik: The home page is reached via {{deger}} redirects
yonlendirme_uzun.neden: Every redirect slows down loading and loses some search value.
yonlendirme_uzun.oneri: Update links and server settings so they point straight to the final address.

ana_sayfa_durum.neden: If the home page returns anything other than 200, visitors and search engines cannot reach the content.
ana_sayfa_durum.oneri: Fix the server error or missing page; the home page should return 200.

sayfa_hatali.neden: Pages listed in the sitemap or menu that fail to load cost trust and rankings.
sayfa_hatali.oneri: Fix these pages, or remove them from the sitemap and redirect to a suitable page.

sikistirma_yok.neden: Uncompressed HTML, CSS and JavaScript make visitors download several times more data.
sikistirma_yok.oneri: Enable brotli or gzip on the server or CDN.

sikistirma_var.neden: Pages download faster with less data.
sikistirma_var.oneri: Check that static files are compressed as well.

onbellek_yok.neden: Without caching rules, browsers and CDNs download everything again on every visit.
onbellek_yok.oneri: Set short Cache-Control for HTML and long-lived caching for versioned static files.

yavas_yanit.baslik: The home page responded in {{deger}} ms
yavas_yanit.neden: When the server is slow, the rest of the page is delayed too.
yavas_yanit.oneri: Use server-side caching, speed up database queries or add a CDN.

hsts_yok.neden: HSTS tells the browser to connect only over HTTPS, making interception attacks harder.

csp_yok.neden: CSP is the strongest layer against injected malicious scripts (XSS).
csp_yok.oneri: Start with Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only to map allowed sources, then enforce the policy.

csp_rapor.baslik: Content Security Policy (CSP) is in report-only mode
csp_rapor.neden: A policy exists but is sent as Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only: the browser only reports violations and does not yet block malicious scripts.
csp_rapor.oneri: Watch the violation reports for a few days; once they are clean, enforce the same policy with the Content-Security-Policy header.

frame_koruma_yok.neden: Your site could be loaded in an invisible frame on another site and used for clickjacking.
frame_koruma_yok.oneri: Set X-Frame-Options: DENY or frame-ancestors 'self' in your CSP.

nosniff_yok.neden: Without it the browser guesses file types, so a malicious file could run as a script.

referrer_yok.neden: When a visitor follows a link, the full URL including its parameters can leak to the other site.

guvenlik_basliklari_tamam.baslik: Core security headers are in place
guvenlik_basliklari_tamam.neden: Basic protection against common browser-level attacks is enabled.
guvenlik_basliklari_tamam.oneri: Keep the CSP up to date when adding third-party scripts.

ssl_gecersiz.neden: Browsers show a full-page warning for invalid certificates and most visitors turn back.
ssl_gecersiz.oneri: Reinstall a certificate that matches the domain from a trusted provider and include intermediate certificates.

ssl_suresi_gecmis.baslik: The SSL certificate expired {{deger}} days ago
ssl_suresi_gecmis.neden: With an expired certificate the browser marks the site as unsafe.
ssl_suresi_gecmis.oneri: Renew the certificate now and turn on automatic renewal.

ssl_bitiyor.baslik: The SSL certificate expires within {{deger}} days
ssl_bitiyor.neden: If it is not renewed, the site will look unsafe within days.
ssl_bitiyor.oneri: Renew the certificate now and check that automatic renewal works.

ssl_yakinda.baslik: The SSL certificate expires in {{deger}} days
ssl_yakinda.neden: Expiry is approaching; if automatic renewal fails, the site will be disrupted.
ssl_yakinda.oneri: Verify automatic renewal or set a calendar reminder.

ssl_gecerli.baslik: The SSL certificate is valid ({{deger}} days left)
ssl_gecerli.neden: The connection is encrypted and browsers trust the site.
ssl_gecerli.oneri: Make sure automatic renewal is enabled.

ssl_olculemedi.baslik: Could not read the SSL expiry date
ssl_olculemedi.neden: We could not connect to the certificate directly during this analysis; this did not lower the score.
ssl_olculemedi.oneri: Check the certificate expiry date via the padlock icon in your browser.

llms_txt_var.neden: AI assistants can reach a summary of your site and its key pages directly.
llms_txt_var.oneri: Keep adding new services and pages to llms.txt.

llms_txt_yok.neden: llms.txt is a new standard that summarises your site for AI tools such as ChatGPT and Claude, helping them describe you accurately.
llms_txt_yok.oneri: Add a /llms.txt at the root summarising your site, services and key pages.

ai_bot_engelli.neden: Blocked crawlers cannot read your site, so you may not appear in those AI search tools.
ai_bot_engelli.oneri: Unless this is a deliberate choice, remove the Disallow: / line for these crawlers.

ai_botlar_acik.neden: GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot and Google-Extended can read your site.
ai_botlar_acik.oneri: Keep content clear and current; these tools may cite you as a source.

yapisal_veri_var.neden: AI systems and search engines can read your business, services and contact details in machine-readable form.
yapisal_veri_var.oneri: Validate the markup regularly with Google's Rich Results Test.

yapisal_veri_yok.neden: AI systems infer who you are and what you offer more reliably from structured data.
yapisal_veri_yok.oneri: Add schema.org JSON-LD such as Organization, LocalBusiness, Service and FAQPage.
